subject: WarehouseEdge PO format, invoice cadence, and packaging discount questions
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@warehouseedge.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Josh Patel <josh.patel@warehouseedge.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: PO format / net terms / discount threshold questions

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the demo last week — WarehouseEdge is interested in moving forward but Finance has a couple of compliance and procurement questions before we can issue a formal PO. Can you confirm the following so we can route internally?

1) PO format: Our eProcurement system requires the PO to reference a single contract line and a Redwood billing entity. Can Redwood accept a single-line PO that references the account number and SOW instead of line-item SKUs?

2) Invoice cadence & net terms: We usually do net60 for platform vendors, invoiced monthly. Is net60 acceptable? If not, what flexibility do you have (net30/45)?

3) Discounts & packaging: We are evaluating a 24-month committed package across two business units. Is there a standard multi-year discount schedule you can share (e.g., 12/24/36 month tiers) and whether discounts apply to committed spend vs. overage?

4) PO header requirements: We need to include our internal cost center and project code on the invoice to automate approvals — can that appear in the PO reference and on each invoice line?

If easier, happy to hop on a 20-min call with your billing/finance lead. I attached our procurement questionnaire for reference.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Sr. Procurement Manager
WarehouseEdge Logistics

Attachment: WarehouseEdge-questions.docx (procurement questionnaire)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@warehouseedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO format / net terms / discount threshold questions

Hi Elena — great to hear WarehouseEdge is progressing. Answers below; copying Marissa (Customer Success) and Naomi (Finance) so we can close this out quickly.

1) PO format: Yes, we can accept a single-line PO that references the Redwood Master Services Agreement (MSA) and SOW/account number. We prefer the PO to include the Redwood billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc., EIN XX-XXXXXXX. We can provide a PO template that matches our billing system. See attached PO-format-guidelines.pdf.

2) Invoice cadence & net terms: Our standard is net30 with monthly invoices. We can make exceptions case-by-case: net45 is commonly approved for enterprise customers; net60 is exceptional and requires finance sign-off and a billing holdback. Naomi, can you confirm internal constraints for a net60 exception and whether Redwood can accept a net60 with an early-payment discount?

3) Discounts & packaging: We offer tiered discounts for committed spend. High-level guidelines: 5% for 12-month prepay/commit, 8% for 24-month committed annual spend, 12% for 36-month commitments. These apply to committed base spend (baseline subscription); overage is billed at list rate unless you convert to a higher committed tranche. Exact pricing and SLAs will go into the SOW. Marissa, happy to propose a packaging recommendation for WarehouseEdge's scale.

4) PO header: We can include your cost center and project code in the PO reference and propagate that onto the invoice line in our accounting system (we typically map it to the invoice memo).

Next steps: Naomi / Marissa — can you confirm whether Redwood can accept net60 under DEAL-4789 if WarehouseEdge signs a 24-month committed package at the 8% tier? Elena — if that trade is acceptable, we can send a redlined SOW + PO template and get DocuSign ready.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PO-format-guidelines.pdf, Redwood-standard-invoice-sample.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: WarehouseEdge PO format / net terms / discount threshold questions

Naomi — forwarding the WarehouseEdge questions. Quick notes:

- Customer is targeting two business units; estimated committed ARR for 24 months is $720k (they sent a preliminary forecast).
- They require net60 as a default. Logistics customers commonly ask for net60; historically we have approved net60 only when there's a payment guarantee or an early pay discount to offset receivables risk.
- We could offer net60 if they agree to one of these: 1) 2% early payment discount if invoice paid within 15 days, or 2) a 6% increase to cover longer receivable window (less desirable sales-wise), or 3) require quarterly invoicing + escrow on first invoice.

Proposal I'd like approved: 24-month commitment at 8% discount, monthly invoicing, Redwood to accept net60 conditioned on a 2% early pay discount (within 15 days) OR an initial 30-day prepayment of the first month to set autopay. Which do you prefer from a risk perspective?

Naomi — can you confirm whether Finance is comfortable with the early-pay discount mechanism and whether we need a billing holdback clause?

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@warehouseedge.com>
Cc: Josh Patel <josh.patel@warehouseedge.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: WarehouseEdge PO format / net terms / discount threshold questions

Hi all — thanks for the details and the numbers. After reviewing with AR and legal:

- Net60: Finance will approve net60 for DEAL-4789 conditional on one of the following: (A) 2% early-pay discount if payment received within 15 days of invoice OR (B) first invoice paid in 30 days as a pilot prepayment and standard monthly invoicing thereafter. We prefer option A as it preserves cash flow and is simpler contractually.

- PO format: Acceptable — the single-line PO referencing MSA/SOW is fine. Please ensure the PO includes: Redwood Inference, Inc. billing entity, our billing address, and your cost center/project code in the PO reference field.

- Discount & packaging: The 8% for a 24-month committed baseline looks reasonable. Confirm whether the 8% applies to baseline committed spend only (yes) and that overage is billed at list price. We'll include language in the SOW clarifying committed baseline, measurement period, and billing for overages.

Next steps for the external thread: Logan/Marissa — please send Elena a short confirmation e-mail that: (1) Redwood accepts single-line PO referencing MSA/SOW; (2) Redwood can accept net60 subject to 2% early-pay discount; (3) Redwood will offer 8% on 24-month committed baseline and overage at list price; and (4) Redwood will place cost-center on invoice references per their request. Attach the PO template and the SOW redline as 'working drafts'.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-net-terms-policy.pdf (internal)
